      4.6 Answer Explanations: Reading Comprehension

         1. According to the passage, traditional corporate leaders differ from leaders in learning
            organizations in that the former
               A. encourage employees to concentrate on developing a wide range of skills
               B. enable employees to recognize and confront dominant corporate models
               C. make important policy decisions alone and then require employees to abide
               D. instill confidence in employees because of their willingness to make risky decisions
               E. are concerned with offering employees frequent advice and career guidance
            Supporting Idea
            The passage contrasts traditional corporate leaders with leaders in learning organizations.
               A. Encouraging employees to develop skills is associated with learning organizations, not traditional ones.
               B. Recognizing and confronting models is associated with learning organizations.
               C. Correct. Traditional leaders make policy decisions alone.
               D. Risk-taking is not the differentiator emphasized in the passage.
               E. Offering frequent advice is not the contrast drawn.
      The correct answer is C.

      4.7 Practice Questions: Critical Reasoning
      Each of the Critical Reasoning questions is based on a short argument.
      Questions 141 to 192 — Difficulty: Easy
      141. PhishCo runs a number of farms in the arid province of Nufa, depending largely on irrigation.
            Which of the following would, if true, most strongly suggest that the plan would succeed?
               A. Most of the vegetation to be placed around the ponds is native to Nufa.
               B. The water in the aquifer is salty enough to prevent fish growth.
               C. The fish raised in the ponds are valuable as a food source.
               D. PhishCo has previously raised fish in similar ponds.
               E. The aquifer water is too warm for the fish to thrive.
      The correct answer is C.
